applications.name: RH2 (volter-ai/runhuman-2)
applications.client: fetch; expo-notifications on physical mobile devices; no enhanced-security access token

backend.call: The away notifier posts an array, one message per phone (to, title, body truncated to 1000 characters, data.url, sound default). It counts ok tickets and deletes a token for DeviceNotRegistered.

frontend.call: A physical phone asks permission, obtains an Expo push token, and registers it with RH2. Native registration is represented by the devices door; the push service has no public server API for this act.
A notification tap opens data.url in the console; device-side display can be inspected through the inbox door.
